lines.text: Nahash the Ammonite besieged Jabesh-gilead and demanded everyone's right eye, so the elders asked for seven days.
The messengers told the people of Gibeah, who wept, and when Saul heard, the Spirit of God rushed upon him.
Saul cut a pair of oxen into pieces and sent them throughout Israel, then counted the troops at Gilgal.
The men of Jabesh rejoiced at the promise of deliverance, and Saul divided the troops into two divisions.
Saul ordered that no one be put to death, and the people confirmed him as king at Gilgal.
